details: Package @vaultflow/create-flow version 1.0.0 contains only two scanned files and shows no code paths performing credential access, environment scraping, install-time or import-time remote fetch-and-execute, silent relay of caller data, backdoor connectivity, or self-propagation. No lifecycle scripts fetching external content, no hardcoded attacker-controlled destinations, and no reads of installer secret paths were observed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
